sentences.en: In Greenmount Cemetery in the north central part of the city are the graves of Junius Brutus Booth, Mme Elizabeth Patterson Bonaparte (1785-1879), the wife of Jerome Bonaparte, Johns Hopkins, John McDonogh and Sidney Lanier.

sentences.en: If you are thinking about moving to an active over 55 adult retirement community, the Lanier Village Estates, located in Gainesville, provides resource style amenities in a beautiful country setting.

sentences.en: However, its ability to fill ink orders for lesser known brands, inclduing Lanier, Royal, Samsung, Savin, and Ricoh, is what really sets it apart from others.
